description: A sample client implementation in PHP for interacting with the TestLink API, primarily demonstrating how to perform various test-related operations via XML-RPC. It includes functions for retrieving test cases, creating test projects, and fetching test suite data, utilizing external classes and functions like IXR_Client and dBug.

classes.name: IXR_Client
classes.description: An external class used for making XML-RPC calls to the server.

classes.name: dBug
classes.description: A debugging utility class used to output variable information

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for IXR_Client, initializes the client with the server URL.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Performs an XML-RPC query with the specified method name and arguments.

methods.name: getErrorCode
methods.description: Retrieves the error code from the last failed query.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Retrieves the error message from the last failed query.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Retrieves the response data from the last successful query.
